{{Top|leg}}
'''Yideg''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. While guarding a client, Yideg used a [[sonic rifle]] to remove two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] disguised as [[Alien/Legends|alien]] dignitaries from a party. Yideg used the sonic rifle to take them out, earning a bonus for the work.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>

Yideg was one of the first in line to purchase [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech's]] [[DL-6H heavy blaster pistol]]. Yideg wanted to get a weapon with a longer range, and was pleasantly surprised to find that the weapon not only had double the range, but also had the weight and feel of a [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="GFT" />
